remarks: Come see this light airy townhouse. This end unit has it all. Great use of space. Welcoming living room with hardwood floors, Fireplace and nearby half bath with convenient kitchen and dining area for comfortable lifestyle. Bedrooms with large Palladian style windows and Ceiling fans for relaxing evenings. Newer laundry units and extra room for office or den space. Attached garage with storage space. Convenient location with short walk to Merritt 7 Train station. Minutes to everything: shopping, entertainment, Merritt Parkway, Rt 7 connector and I-95 access. There are large windows allowing light to stream in everywhere. Pet Friendly and New C/A ...This place has it all. Please make sure cat styas inside for showings
